confidence: provisional — split between two hypotheses, pending a real daylight swatch test

hypotheses.name: Deep Winter
hypotheses.evidence: Self-named favourites: emerald glasses (worn daily), dusty-purple tee — both clear, cool jewel tones, chosen and loved.

hypotheses.name: Deep Autumn
hypotheses.evidence: Best-lit photo (overcast daylight): skin holds real warmth despite the light's cooling cast; a mustard tee reads genuinely well in that photo.

rules.faceRule: Near the face (tops, shirts, knitwear): core neutrals + clear jewel tones. Below the waist (trousers, shoes): far more forgiving — existing olive/khaki/camel all work here regardless of which hypothesis is correct.

avoid: triadic and split-complementary as literal 3-hue combos — collapse to two colours plus a neutral instead
